Last season I put a little manure and some fertilizer on my maize, and that piece gave me better cobs than the one I left weak. This plot is mine, so I will not leave it empty of feed, but I will keep the cost low because cash is not easy and fertilizer does not always come on time from the cooperative. I will plant the improved maize seed I have seen working on nearby fields, use manure from home, and depend on the rains. I will weed mostly with family hands, and I will only bring a few laborers when the work is heavy.
